title: VisionQuest
overview: Vision, rebooted and having escaped from those who sought to weaponize him, has been in hiding. Searching for new meaning, he consults the AI personas embedded in his programming, including F.R.I.D.A.Y., E.D.I.T.H., J.A.R.V.I.S., and the infamous Ultron. His discreet existence ends when a bounty placed on his head thrusts him on the run with Thomas Shepard, a mysterious boy who may be Vision's son, reincarnate. As Vision evades capture, he must confront his nature, resist Ultron's influence, and unravel the enigma that is his young companion if he's to survive.

episodes.overview: Vision embarks on a journey of self-discovery and finds himself hunted by a deadly force.

episodes.title: Theseus

episodes.title: Immolation
episodes.overview: Vision and Ultron's twisted relationship comes undone.

episodes.title: Forever
episodes.overview: Vision's quest to embrace his true identity comes to a close.

title: Snowfall
overview: Los Angeles, 1983. A storm is coming and it's name is crack. Snowfall is a one-hour drama set against the infancy of the crack cocaine epidemic and it's ultimate radical impact on the culture as we know it. The story follows three characters on a violent collision course: Franklin Saint, young street entrepreneur on a quest for power; Gustavo "El Oso" Zapata, a Mexican wrestler caught up in a power struggle within a crime family; Teddy McDonald, a CIA operative running from a dark past who begins an off-book operation to fund the Nicaraguan Contras and Lucia Villanueva, the self-possessed daughter of a Mexican crime lord.

episodes.overview: South Central street entrepreneur Franklin Saint takes a leap into the cocaine game. Disgruntled CIA officer Teddy McDonald allies with a Contra soldier. Luchador wrestler Gustavo "El Oso" Zapata makes inroads with a Mexican cartel family.

title: Power Book III: Raising Kanan
overview: Power Book III: Raising Kanan is a prequel story that takes viewers back to the '90s and the early years of iconic Power character Kanan Stark.

episodes.title: Back in the Day
episodes.overview: In 1991 in South Jamaica, Queens,15-year-old Kanan Stark is eager to join his family's growing drug business that is led by his mother, Raquel Raq Thomas.

episodes.title: Reaping and Sowing
episodes.overview: After a rival crewmember is killed, Raq does whatever is necessary to get the target off Kanan's back.

episodes.title: Stick and Move
episodes.overview: Still reeling from a shocking death, Kanan pushes his way into the drug game with Marvin's help while Raq plots to take down her competition.

episodes.title: Don't Sleep
episodes.overview: All bets are off when a police raid clears out Raq's competition. Promises are broken, secrets are revealed, and revenge is swift.

episodes.title: Choose Your Battles
episodes.overview: Eager to transform her business after the stash house is hit, Raq overhauls her operation. Meanwhile, Kanan is detained after a fight with Scrappy.

episodes.title: Level Up
episodes.overview: Lou's new artist showcase becomes the nexus of the rivalry between Raq and Unique. At the same time, Kanan cooks up a drug-selling scheme with Marvin.

episodes.title: Stay in Your Lane
episodes.overview: Kanan and Marvin's side hustle goes awry. Raq seeks revenge for the attack on Scrappy. Jukebox suffers a devastating blow.

episodes.title: The Cost of Business
episodes.overview: Kanan struggles with a harsh truth after word gets back to Raq that he's behind the bad crack on the streets.

episodes.title: Loyal to the End
episodes.overview: As Marvin seeks revenge, Raq turns to Kanan for assistance only he can provide.

episodes.title: Paid in Full
episodes.overview: As the situation in the neighborhood turns dire, Raq scrambles to get Kanan out of harm's way.

episodes.title: The More Things Change
episodes.overview: Kanan returns to Queens where Raq is trying to mend the many fractures in the Thomas family. As Raq expands her empire, Kanan doubts his future in the drug game. Meanwhile, Detective Howard is released from the hospital.

episodes.title: Mind Your Business
episodes.overview: Raq learns she may have a snitch and tasks Marvin with confirming the rumor. Lou brings in a potential new artist, but he and Crown disagree. Kanan helps Famous sell mix tapes. Jukebox tracks down her estranged mother.

episodes.title: Sleeping Dogs
episodes.overview: A surprise encounter with Howard leaves Kanan rattled. Raq tries to expand into new territory but when an associate and valuables go missing, she is reunited with an old adversary. Lou continues to butt heads with Crown.

episodes.title: Pay the Toll
episodes.overview: Kanan and Jukebox search for answers in family matters. When Raq's push into new territory is stalled, she proposes a meeting. Crown helps Famous get settled. Still investigating Howard's shooting, Burke questions Unique.

episodes.title: What Happens in the Catskills
episodes.overview: Raq focuses on mother-son bonding with Kanan in the Catskills, but they're interrupted when business follows them. Crown disrespects Lou, bringing their simmering beef to a boil. Burke digs into Howard's personal life.

episodes.title: It's a Business, Man
episodes.overview: Raq assures everyone they need to follow orders and keep working as planned. Kanan takes on more responsibility but things go wrong when he runs into neighborhood kids. Lou feels the pressure in his partnership with Crown.

episodes.title: No Love Lost
episodes.overview: Raq searches for a new home. Lou finds himself on the other side of his partner's unpaid debts. Burke gains traction in her investigation on Howard. A botched agreement with Marvin and an associate threatens everything.

episodes.title: A House Is Not a Home
episodes.overview: The rift between Raq and Kanan grows, and Kanan seeks comfort elsewhere. Marvin lays low, waiting for the consequences of his actions to blow over. Raq sees dark clouds on the horizon.

episodes.title: Anti-Trust
episodes.overview: With his living situation threatened, Famous reaches out to Lou as a last-ditch effort. Raq receives a new business proposal and must eliminate a threat. Burke closes in on what really happened in Baisley Park.

episodes.title: If Y'Don't Know, Now Y'Know
episodes.overview: Decidedly his own man, Kanan strays further from his mother and sets up shop on his own on the corners of South Jamaica; worried about retaliation, Raq questions Unique; Lou's rift with Raq grows when he makes a discovery.

episodes.title: Home Sweet Home
episodes.overview: Raq makes a life-changing decision in the aftermath of the Mafia's ambush, but its too little, too late for Kanan, as he looks to pave his own path free of his mother's lies.

episodes.title: Flipmode
episodes.overview: Raq continues her farewell tour with one last job for the Mafia while Kanan dives further into the drug game with an innovative business idea. Howard faces a new threat at the precinct.

episodes.overview: As paranoia sets in for Raq and Howard over the Task Force, Kanan and Famous launch their weed delivery business, Jukebox prepares for her audition, and Ronnie grows impatient with Unique.

episodes.overview: Raq and Marvin navigate a precarious situation; Kanan and Breeze deepen their partnership; Jukebox hatches a plan.

episodes.overview: Facing pressure from all sides, Raq struggles to maintain control as alliances crumble, and Kanan's growing ruthlessness threatens his relationships.

episodes.overview: Everything has led up to this.

title: Suits
overview: Suits delves into the fast-paced, high-stakes world of a top Manhattan corporate law firm where hotshot associate Harvey Specter makes a risky move by hiring Mike Ross a brilliant but unmotivated college dropout, as his associate. As he becomes enmeshed in this unfamiliar world, Mike relies heavily on the firm's best paralegal Rachel Zane and Harvey's no-nonsense assistant Donna Paulsen to help him serve justice. With a photographic memory and the street smarts of a hustler, Mike proves to be a legal prodigy despite the absence of bonafide legal credentials.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.overview: Successful lawyer Harvey Specter hires brilliant college dropout Mike Ross as a new associate at a top law firm despite the fact that Mike doesn't have a degree. In order to work together, both parties have to keep up the ruse to convince their coworkers that Mike is a real lawyer.

episodes.title: Errors and Omissions
episodes.overview: Mike has an ethical dilemma when Louis forces him to make a decision that could hurt his relationship with Harvey. Elsewhere, Harvey's past comes back to haunt him during a case.

episodes.title: Inside Track
episodes.overview: Harvey goes rogue in order to fix a crisis with a client despite Jessica's desire to reign him in. Elsewhere, Mike turns to Rachel for guidance when he learns he'll be hosting a dinner for rookies, an important tradition at the firm.

episodes.title: Dirty Little Secrets
episodes.overview: Harvey defends a figure from Jessica's past, making it difficult for Jessica to detach herself from the case. Elsewhere, Mike is eager to take on a pro bono case but soon learns it won't be an easy win.

episodes.title: Bail Out
episodes.overview: An old friend surfaces to ask Mike for help. Elsewhere, Harvey has a chance to close a lucrative deal or help his driver defend himself from a lawsuit.

episodes.title: Tricks of the Trade
episodes.overview: The guys defend a woman falsely accused of insider trading. Elsewhere, Mike helps Rachel study for the LSAT and realises she's close to discovering his secret.

episodes.title: Play the Man
episodes.overview: Mike takes on Louis' protégé during a mock trial, but his conflict with Rachel could hurt his chances of winning. Elsewhere, Harvey works on a merger between two hotel chains, but his past with the opposing counsel complicates matters.

episodes.title: Identity Crisis
episodes.overview: Harvey and Louis are forced to work together to go after an investment firm that ripped off a nonprofit. But Louis, anxious to make a good impression, inadvertently hurts the case. Elsewhere, Mike tries to contain a modern-day Robin Hood whose actions are damaging a client's business.

episodes.title: Undefeated
episodes.overview: Harvey takes on an undefeated lawyer from Boston during a class-action lawsuit.

episodes.title: The Shelf Life
episodes.overview: Mike questions the firing of an executive, whom Harvey dismissed at the request of a client.

episodes.title: Rules of the Game
episodes.overview: Harvey's former mentor (Gary Cole) turns to his protégé when his office comes under investigation. Elsewhere, Mike and Louis try to settle a mogul's estate in the midst of family clashes; and Jenny worries that Mike is hiding something.

episodes.title: Dog Fight
episodes.overview: In the first-series finale, Harvey tries to free an innocent man but hits a wall when he goes to the district attorney (Chi McBride), who seems more focused on preserving the system than seeking justice. Elsewhere, Trevor causes problems for Mike when he shows up on Mike's doorstep.

episodes.title: She Knows
episodes.overview: In the Series 2 opener, Mike is excited to close a big case for the firm but doesn't realise Trevor confronted Jessica. Meanwhile, Jessica's former partner resurfaces, prompting Harvey to reconsider what he's willing to do to protect Mike's secret.

episodes.title: The Choice
episodes.overview: Jessica tries to drum up support in the firm and asks Harvey to help her with the task, but his ambition may produce more ill will than good. Elsewhere, Mike approaches Rachel about her message.

episodes.title: Meet the New Boss
episodes.overview: Harvey and Daniel clash over a case, leaving Mike caught in the middle. Meanwhile, Mike must handle problems with the women in his life; and Louis meets a worthy opponent when trying to quell complaints about the way the firm treats its associates.

episodes.title: Discovery
episodes.overview: Travis returns to town and takes aim at Harvey, causing trouble that Harvey and Jessica must hide from Daniel. Elsewhere, Louis and Mike become closer as friends, but Louis' paranoia threatens to ruin the new bond.

episodes.title: Break Point
episodes.overview: Jessica takes the lead on a case that could have serious consequences for the firm, and Harvey has a hard time taking a backseat during the proceedings. Elsewhere, Mike works on a dispute between a tennis phenom and his trainer, who's also his father.

episodes.title: All In
episodes.overview: Harvey and Mike take on an unorthodox case in light of Harvey's history with the client. Elsewhere, Louis and Rachel join forces to preserve a beloved institution, and Jessica encounters a problem while defending the firm.

episodes.title: Sucker Punch
episodes.overview: Harvey turns to an old colleague for help defending the firm against the lawsuit despite the pair's tumultuous past.

episodes.title: Rewind
episodes.overview: Mike and Harvey look into the past to discover how their decisions have influenced the present.

episodes.title: Asterisk
episodes.overview: Harvey tries to sway an important figure whose vote will determine the firm's future.

episodes.title: High Noon
episodes.overview: Personal issues cause Mike to drop off the grid when Harvey needs him during the fight for the firm.

episodes.title: Blind-Sided
episodes.overview: A criminal case resonates with Mike, making it difficult for him to separate his feelings from the case.

episodes.title: Blood in the Water
episodes.overview: The firm tries to recover from the battle with Daniel, but Harvey must fend off another attack from a rival who seems to have a personal vendetta. Elsewhere, Mike and Louis face consequences for previous actions.

episodes.title: Zane vs. Zane
episodes.overview: Harvey faces off with Rachel's father on a gender-discrimination case, forcing Rachel to deal with her strained relationship with her dad.

episodes.title: He's Back
episodes.overview: Daniel returns with a lawsuit against Jessica.

episodes.title: Normandy
episodes.overview: Dana resurfaces and causes problems for Harvey and Jessica in their battle against Hardman.

episodes.title: War
episodes.overview: In the Series 2 finale, Harvey and Jessica clash over their vision for the direction of the firm when faced with a lucrative offer from a British firm.

episodes.title: The Arrangement
episodes.overview: In the Series 3 premiere, new partner Darby assigns Harvey a high-stakes case. Elsewhere, Mike tries to make things right with Harvey and deal with the fallout from his revelation to Rachel.

episodes.title: I Want You to Want Me
episodes.overview: Louis has an offer for Mike that could affect his future at the firm; Harvey and Jessica take on an old foe, who throws a wrench into their defense of Ava Hessington.

episodes.title: Unfinished Business
episodes.overview: Harvey's client is arrested for murder; Katrina attempts to win over Louis, who's still stewing over Mike's rejection; and a British version of Harvey makes waves at the firm.

episodes.title: Conflict of Interest
episodes.overview: Harvey and Louis are at odds when Harvey's defense of Ava conflicts with Louis' assignment to prevent a hostile takeover of Hessington Oil.

episodes.title: Shadow of a Doubt
episodes.overview: Harvey and Stephen join forces for Ava's defense; Mike asks Rachel for help with a case, but complications arise when her parents end up coming close to learning his secret.

episodes.title: The Other Time
episodes.overview: Cameron's dirty tactics on Ava's case lead Harvey to recall why he left the D.A.'s office. Elsewhere, Mike looks back at what prevented him from earning a degree while Rachel visits law schools.

episodes.title: She's Mine
episodes.overview: Harvey butts heads with Stephen over Ava's case and other issues; Harvey and Jessica must overcome the tension between them to work on Ava's defense; and Louis seeks help from Rachel in his battle with Nigel.

episodes.title: Endgame
episodes.overview: Ava's murder trial begins as Mike, Harvey and Jessica navigate a series of betrayals. Elsewhere, Louis and Donna each seek revenge.

episodes.title: Bad Faith
episodes.overview: Harvey and Scottie find themselves at odds once again, while Louis persuades Jessica to let him handle the dissolution talks. Elsewhere, Mike makes a big move in his relationship with Rachel.

episodes.title: Stay
episodes.overview: Harvey and Scottie find themselves on opposite sides when an old enemy complicates the Pearson Darby negotiations. Elsewhere, Sheila and Louis are at odds over a new hire, and Jessica is unhappy with Mike and Rachel.

episodes.title: Buried Secrets
episodes.overview: Complications arise between Harvey, Jessica and Scottie; Mike faces his demons during a case against an old enemy; Louis' suspicions may expose Mike.

episodes.title: Yesterday's Gone
episodes.overview: Jessica finds an unlikely friend in Harvey as her concerns continue to mount.

episodes.title: Moot Point
episodes.overview: Harvey faces an old rival from law school; Jessica tries to stay out of Louis and Scottie's feud.

episodes.title: Heartburn
episodes.overview: A major client demands that Harvey and Mike perform an unpleasant task; Louis faces a difficult challenge; Rachel collects an old debt.

episodes.title: Know When to Fold 'Em
episodes.overview: A persistent attorney goes after one of Harvey's clients; Mike is faced with a difficult decision; former name partner Charles Van Dyke returns with revenge on his mind.

episodes.title: No Way Out
episodes.overview: Harvey and Mike clash with a tenacious U.S. attorney in the Series 3 finale. Elsewhere, Scottie and Harvey struggle to reach a compromise, and Mike and Rachel have different ideas about the future.

episodes.title: One-Two-Three Go...
episodes.overview: Mike and Harvey clash over investment-banking strategies in the Season 4 opener. Meanwhile, Pearson realizes a former district attorney may be pursuing revenge against Harvey and the firm.

episodes.title: Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner
episodes.overview: A takeover battle pits Harvey and Mike against one another, and the situation is only complicated further by Mike's relationship with Rachel. Elsewhere, Louis partners with recent SEC defector Jeff Malone.

episodes.title: Two in the Knees
episodes.overview: Logan Sanders, a client of Pearson Specter, looks to Harvey to confirm that his relationship with Mike won't prevent them from winning the takeover battle. Elsewhere, misunderstandings arise between Louis and his new colleague Jeff Malone.

episodes.title: Leveraged
episodes.overview: Mike initiates a hostile takeover of Gillis Industries while Harvey and Louis work feverishly against his efforts. Elsewhere, Jessica and Malone meet with Sean Cahill, who has the weight of the SEC behind him in bringing down the firm.

episodes.title: Pound of Flesh
episodes.overview: Rachel becomes increasingly anxious about work, school, and the growing attraction between herself and Pearson Specter client Logan Sanders. Meanwhile, Louis helps Donna prepare for a major role while she encourages him to face his fear. Harvey and Mike agree to a ceasefire, but Sam accuses him of collusion and Mike learns how ruthless his new partner can be.

episodes.title: Litt the Hell Up
episodes.overview: Harvey tries to end the takeover when Sean Cahill brings Pearson Specter client Logan Sanders to the SEC for questioning. Elsewhere, Louis finds a way to make a name for himself when Mike insists on playing hardball.

episodes.title: We're Done
episodes.overview: Rachel brings disturbing news while Mike is still reeling from the aftermath of the battle for Gillis Industries. Feeling Harvey is his only friend left, Mike makes a rash decision; elsewhere, Jessica asks Louis to pick his own reward after his victory for the firm.

episodes.title: Exposure
episodes.overview: Mike and Rachel work closely with one another while Jessica and Harvey try to outmaneuver Sean Cahill. Elsewhere, Louis tries to hide evidence for the sake of his career.

episodes.title: Gone
episodes.overview: Professional and personal secrets are unearthed when Sean begins a round of depositions as the SEC investigation comes to a head.

episodes.title: This Is Rome
episodes.overview: Harvey and Jessica try to protect the firm from competitors; Louis tries to balance his personal and professional affairs.

episodes.title: Enough Is Enough
episodes.overview: Gabriel Macht directs the Season 4 mid-season premiere, which finds Louis gaining leverage in his quest to become a name partner of the firm; and the Pearson Specter team dealing with the fallout of Louis learning Mike's secret.

episodes.title: Respect
episodes.overview: Harvard ethics professor Henry Gerard seeks Harvey's help with a case that requires a lack of ethics to win. Mike, meanwhile, does his best to not be spotted by the professor, whose class he never took; and Louis tries to wine and dine a socialite CEO.

episodes.title: Fork in the Road
episodes.overview: Harvey and Louis travel to see a client to whom they have deep ties; and Harvey takes advantage of the time to force Louis and Mike to confront their trust issues. In other events, in a flashback, the root of Harvey and Louis's competitive relationship is explained; and Mike learns the limits of his intelligence when it comes to the law.

episodes.title: Derailed
episodes.overview: When Mike takes a humanitarian case with the potential to jeopardize firm business, Harvey must decide how much to rein in his associate. Meanwhile, Jessica wrestles with the distance she's been forced to put between herself and Jeff Malone. And Louis fights to get the respect a name partner deserves.

episodes.title: Intent
episodes.overview: Harvey and Mike scramble to save the Liberty Rail case; D.A. Wolf comes after the firm; and Jessica and Malone try to adjust to their new circumstances.

episodes.title: Not Just a Pretty Face
episodes.overview: When SEC investigator Sean Cahill fails to link his corrupt boss Eric Woodall with corporate raider Charles Forstman, Harvey consults with Jessica but must ultimately revisit his own uncomfortable past in order to find a way to put them away for good. Mike and Rachel confront the fact that, while Rachel is Harvey's associate, Mike is his guy. And Donna helps Louis with an unexpected crisis.

episodes.title: Denial
episodes.overview: In the Season 5 premiere, Harvey's work is impacted by changes around the office; and Donna adjusts to working for Louis, who believes she's certain to return to Harvey. In other events, Mike and Rachel must decide how and when to share their big news.

episodes.title: Compensation
episodes.overview: Harvey searches for a replacement for Donna. Mike takes a case as a favor, which he must justify to Jessica - while Rachel's father, Robert Zane, offers some unsolicited advice about Rachel's engagement to Mike. And Louis is embroiled in surprising money matters, while an up-and-coming partner, Jack, makes his presence known to Jessica, confronting her about whether Harvey's way of doing business is beneficial to the firm.

episodes.title: No Refills
episodes.overview: Harvey brings some star power to his ongoing conflict with Jack Soloff - a conflict that Louis and Donna can't seem to stay clear of. Mike brings in Robert Zane to co-counsel a case, pitting his instincts as a lawyer against his desire to stay in his future father-in-law's good graces. And while Jessica mediates between Mike and Zane, she tasks Rachel with an unusual assignment.

episodes.title: No Puedo Hacerlo
episodes.overview: Harvey steps outside his usual area of expertise, in order to take a case from a client who has a special tie to the firm. Mike and Zane work their class-action case together, but Mike learns they have different ideas about what constitutes a win - for themselves, and for their clients. And Donna counsels Louis on the best way to settle a feud.

episodes.title: Toe to Toe
episodes.overview: When Harvey's bitter rival Travis Tanner turns up on the other side of a case, claiming to be a changed man, Harvey and Mike must decide whether to believe him - or bury him. As Harvey's sessions with Dr. Agard continue, she links his personal stake in the Tanner fight to issues from his past. Meanwhile, Jessica tasks Louis to make things right with Harvey, and with Rachel and Donna's help he devises a plan - one which could make an enemy of the formidable Jack Soloff.

episodes.title: Privilege
episodes.overview: Reeling from Dr. Agard's revelation about the root of his panic attacks, Harvey is forced to make a tough personal decision in a case that touches a nerve. Meanwhile, Mike and Louis have taken over responsibility for Harvey's oldest client, and must decide what to do when that client's demands go against his own best interests. And Donna tries to work her magic to make Rachel's dream wedding possible.

episodes.title: Hitting Home
episodes.overview: Mike teams with Jack Soloff on a case; Esther Litt returns to P.S.L. in hopes of discreetly solving a problem; and Donna and Harvey try to return their friendship to normal.

episodes.title: Mea Culpa
episodes.overview: Jessica does damage control in the wake of Harvey punching Louis, just as Jack Soloff and Daniel Hardman are looking for weaknesses to exploit. Meanwhile, Donna counsels both men on how to rectify their issues. And Mike must find a way to turn down his recently announced promotion without raising suspicion - while he and Rachel combat an opposing attorney who holds the key to uncovering his secret.

episodes.title: Uninvited Guests
episodes.overview: Rachel and her mother, Laura Zane, plan for Rachel's dream wedding, but Rachel fears the event may reveal Mike's secret. Meanwhile Daniel Hardman and Jack Soloff make their move against Jessica and the partners, as Harvey and Mike tangle with Hardman's mysterious backer, and Louis tries to find Jack's Achilles heel.

episodes.title: Faith
episodes.overview: Jessica and Louis try to rally the partners to stop the takeover attempt by Hardman and Soloff. In other events, Mike and Harvey each face down past demons in order to make potentially life-altering decisions.

episodes.title: Blowback
episodes.overview: As we begin our mid-season premiere, Mike's worst fears have come true. He's been arrested for fraud and is under investigation by a ruthless government prosecutor, Assistant US Attorney Anita Gibbs. Meanwhile, Jessica and Harvey must figure out how to build a defense for Mike, knowing full well that he's guilty of the crime for which he stands accused. And Rachel must come to terms with her family's reaction to the news that her fiancé is not the person he claimed to be - and that he could soon be in prison.

episodes.title: Live to Fight
episodes.overview: Mike and Louis must identify an anonymous tipster in order to diffuse a damning piece of evidence. Meanwhile, Gibbs isn't just after Mike, she's set her sights on Jessica and Harvey as well

episodes.title: God's Green Earth
episodes.overview: With time running out before Mike's case goes to trial, Harvey and Mike are at odds over their strategy, and just what lengths they'll go to in order to defeat Gibbs.

episodes.title: Self Defense
episodes.overview: As time runs out before the trial, Mike wants to represent himself while Harvey wants to lead the charge. To decide the issue, Harvey challenges Mike to a winner takes all showdown.

episodes.title: Tick Tock
episodes.overview: With things looking bad for the firm, Louis mulls over Anita Gibbs' offer to turn on his compatriots in exchange for immunity. Meanwhile, Rachel gives Mike advice on how best to win hearts and minds in the courtroom. As the pressure mounts, Donna pleads with Harvey to not do anything rash, even as Jessica encourages him to do so. And Harvey and Mike look to a new, last-ditch strategy to win the case.. but as they run out of moves to play and deals to make, they face the possibility of putting Mike's fate in the last place they want it - the hands of a jury.

episodes.title: 25th Hour
episodes.overview: Mike makes the one play he has left when faced with a court battle that could go either way.

episodes.title: To Trouble
episodes.overview: Season 6 begins immediately following the events of the shocking Season 5 cliffhanger that left Mike behind bars. After signing a plea deal to spare his colleagues at Pearson Specter Litt, Mike will be confronted with the harsh realities of prison life as he starts his two-year sentence. Meanwhile, the once bustling Pearson Specter Litt offices are a ghost town – the partners have defected, leaving Harvey, Jessica (Gina Torres), Louis (Rick Hoffman), Donna (Sarah Rafferty) and Rachel (Meghan Markle) to pick up the pieces. But the firm's troubles are far from over and they will have to deal with the fallout from Mike's crime before they can even begin to rebuild.

episodes.title: Accounts Payable
episodes.overview: PSL faces a class action lawsuit from former clients; and Mike has problems with a fellow prisoner.

episodes.title: Back on the Map
episodes.overview: Mike tries to remain safe without breaking Danbury's unwritten rules; Jessica and Harvey try to land a whale; Louis searches for an office tenant; and Rachel faces a fellow student

episodes.title: Turn
episodes.overview: Mike may take a deal to reduce his sentence; Jessica and Louis have different ways of dealing with their new tenants; and Rachel represents a death-row inmate.

episodes.title: Trust
episodes.overview: Mike tries to gain Kevin's trust while Harvey enacts a risky plan; Jessica mends the firm's reputation; Rachel runs into a roadblock; and Louis enlists Donna's help in a matter of the heart.

episodes.title: Spain
episodes.overview: Harvey defends Sutter from Cahill; Mike's past threatens to derail his mission; Rachel and Jessica search for evidence to re-open Bailey's case; and Louis woos Tara with a trip to the Hamptons.

episodes.title: Shake the Trees
episodes.overview: Harvey, Louis and Donna search for a link to Sutter's inside trading; Mike goes to extremes to get Kevin on his side; and Rachel and Jessica deliver bad news to Leonard Bailey.

episodes.title: Borrowed Time
episodes.overview: Harvey rebuts Cahill's star witness; and Mike tries to deliver one of his own. In other events, Jessica and Rachel try to delay Leonard's execution; and Louis adjusts to life as "the other man."

episodes.title: The Hand That Feeds You
episodes.overview: In order to protect Mike, Harvey considers putting Gallo back on the streets; Jessica and Rachel get Bailey's case re-opened; Louis deals with anxiety over Tara.

episodes.title: P.S.L.
episodes.overview: Jessica and Rachel fight to save Leonard Bailey; Harvey and Louis try to keep clients from abandoning ship by wooing their oldest client.

episodes.title: She's Gone
episodes.overview: Harvey, Louis and Donna plan for the future, after Jessica's departure from Pearson Specter Litt. Mike discovers the perils of life as an ex-convict. And Rachel considers her options for life after law school.

episodes.title: The Painting
episodes.overview: Harvey tries to repair a broken relationship - leaving Louis, Donna and Rachel to manage PSL in his absence. Meanwhile, Mike gets a helping hand from an unexpected place.

episodes.title: Teeth, Nose, Teeth
episodes.overview: Rachel receives a letter that creates an unexpected issue for Harvey and Louis. Mike's mentorship of Oliver and Marissa gets put to the test. And Donna gets a surprise from the IT department.

episodes.title: Admission of Guilt
episodes.overview: Harvey and Mike walk a fine line when they partner on a class action; Louis needs Rachel's help impressing a client during an annual presentation; and Donna and Benjamin refine their product.

episodes.title: Quid Pro Quo
episodes.overview: When Mike's class action hits a snag, it might cost him more than the case; Harvey, Louis and Rachel consider getting their hands dirty; and Donna and Benjamin seek an investor.

episodes.title: Character and Fitness
episodes.overview: Mike needs Harvey and Rachel's help to overcome an impossible obstacle, or his dream of becoming a real lawyer is over. Donna's new venture hits a snag. Louis tries to patch things up with Tara.

episodes.title: Skin in the Game
episodes.overview: Mike returns to Pearson Specter Litt as Harvey takes the reins. Louis manages the new class of associates while Donna and Rachel find their places in the new world order.

episodes.title: The Statue
episodes.overview: Harvey butts heads with his partners over a bold move. Mike pursues a pro bono case with the legal clinic. Donna's actions raise tough questions at the firm.

episodes.title: Mudmare
episodes.overview: Louis and Harvey struggle with new firm dynamics; Mike gains new business; Rachel's leadership is challenged by an associate.

episodes.title: Divide and Conquer
episodes.overview: Harvey, Louis and Donna must get on the same page when Bratton Gould comes after PSL; Mike and Rachel cannot make time for wedding plans.

episodes.title: Brooklyn Housing
episodes.overview: Mike juggles his work obligations with his promise to help a hurting family. Harvey asks for Louis's discretion in handling a sensitive matter. Donna vets a possible addition to the firm.

episodes.title: Home to Roost
episodes.overview: Mike deals with blowback on his prison case. Harvey struggles to tell Donna about his relationship with Paula. Louis's past poor behavior comes back to haunt him.

episodes.title: Full Disclosure
episodes.overview: Harvey learns the scope of Alex's involvement in the prison case, while Mike races to keep it alive. Lipschitz forces Louis out of his comfort zone. Donna struggles with her work/life balance.
Harvey and Mike seek outside help to overcome an impossible situation. An unexpected encounter derails Louis's search for a new associate. Donna receives a surprising proposition.

episodes.title: Shame
episodes.overview: Mike proposes a power move to boost business, but Harvey's past complicates matters. Rachel is surprised when her dad offers a chance to join forces. Louis mentors Brian.

episodes.title: Donna
episodes.overview: In the Mid-Season finale Mike and Harvey's power move is countered, putting their backs up against the ropes. Rachel fears her father's judgment is clouded by the past. Louis aids Alex when his client comes under fire.

episodes.title: Hard Truths
episodes.overview: Harvey and Louis fight to protect the future of the firm from its past; Alex worries Mike's instincts could risk a client relationship; Donna and Harvey delve into the aftermath of their kiss.

episodes.title: Bad Man
episodes.overview: Harvey has to call in an old debt for the firm. Mike goes toe-to-toe with an unlikely opponent. Louis comes to terms with his new role.

episodes.title: Inevitable
episodes.overview: Harvey is forced into a difficult decision when the impossible is asked of him. Mike and Rachel try to make time to discuss their future. Louis struggles with the rules of his relationship.

episodes.title: Pulling the Goalie
episodes.overview: Mike's attempt to distract Harvey with a case backfires. Louis tries not to let emotion affect his judgment in a legal duel. Donna finds a way to prove her worth to the firm.

episodes.title: Tiny Violin
episodes.overview: An attack against Specter Litt blindsides Harvey and Louis; Mike can't turn his back on the clinic when a class action suit overwhelms Nathan and Oliver.

episodes.title: Good-Bye
episodes.overview: It's all hands on deck as Louis, Donna and Alex defend the firm, while Harvey aids Jessica on a case; Mike and Rachel juggle their commitments to the firm, the clinic and each other.

episodes.title: Right-Hand Man
episodes.overview: Following the merger, Harvey and Zane grapple over who should lead the firm. Louis tasks Katrina with culling the herd, but doesn't like her decision. Donna helps her see beyond the numbers.

episodes.title: Pecking Order
episodes.overview: Harvey and Donna get a taste of how Samantha operates. Sheila forces Louis to examine his priorities. Katrina points Alex toward a client he hopes will impress Zane.

episodes.title: Promises, Promises
episodes.overview: Harvey is drawn into a dispute with the firm's landlord. Alex pursues Samantha's former client.

episodes.title: Revenue Per Square Foot
episodes.overview: Alex is caught between Harvey and Zane as Louis struggles to overcome a shocking setback.

episodes.title: Good Mudding
episodes.overview: Harvey confronts his personal issues to defend his brother. Louis sacrifices for family.

episodes.title: Cats, Ballet, Harvey Specter
episodes.overview: Harvey and Louis assess their relationship. Donna doubts Samantha's motives for helping her.

episodes.title: Sour Grapes
episodes.overview: Donna's agreement forces Harvey to help David Fox. Alex comes to Zane's aid on a personal venture.

episodes.title: Coral Gables
episodes.overview: Harvey helps Samantha settle an old score. Louis faces a hurdle on the path to fatherhood.

episodes.title: Motion to Delay
episodes.overview: An old foe backs the firm into a corner. Samantha and Alex try to broker a peace between clients.

episodes.title: Managing Partner
episodes.overview: When Harvey and Zane can't stay on the sidelines, Donna does what's best for the firm.

episodes.title: Rocky 8
episodes.overview: Harvey laces up for a rematch against an old foe. Louis struggles to hold the reins of the firm.

episodes.title: Whale Hunt
episodes.overview: Louis learns the finer points of managing Harvey; Alex is caught between Samantha and his wife

episodes.title: The Greater Good
episodes.overview: Harvey and Donna are caught in the crosshairs when Stu is blackmailed. Samantha revisits her past.

episodes.title: Peas in a Pod
episodes.overview: Harvey's forced to choose a side when Samantha and Scottie go toe-to-toe; Louis represents Lipschitz.

episodes.title: Stalking Horse
episodes.overview: Donna's relationship complicates a deal for Harvey and Alex. Samantha helps Louis get justice.

episodes.title: Harvey
episodes.overview: When Hardman comes looking for retribution, the firm rallies to Harvey's defense.

episodes.title: Everything's Changed
episodes.overview: Harvey and Samantha fight to keep Zane's name on the wall; Alex warns Louis of the consequences.

episodes.title: Special Master
episodes.overview: The firm faces the repercussions of their actions. Samantha enlists Katrina to help an old friend.

episodes.title: Windmills
episodes.overview: Harvey takes on a new case in order to send Faye a message; Louis is presented with a new opportunity.

episodes.title: Cairo
episodes.overview: Faye decides to take action against Harvey and Donna's relationship; Harvey looks to impress Donna's father.

episodes.title: If the Shoe Fits
episodes.overview: Samantha gets caught in the middle when Mike picks a fight with Harvey.

episodes.title: Whatever It Takes
episodes.overview: Harvey makes a play to get Samantha's job back. Katrina faces off against an old friend.

episodes.title: Scenic Route
episodes.overview: Harvey and Samantha go on a road trip. Louis gets in over his head with a potential client.

episodes.title: Prisoner's Dilemma
episodes.overview: An old foe forces Harvey to account for past actions. Esther has a problem only Louis can solve.

episodes.title: Thunder Away
episodes.overview: Mike helps Harvey get over a personal loss; an attempt to take down Faye becomes complicated.

episodes.title: One Last Con
episodes.overview: Facing its potential destruction, the partners must go all in to save the firm.
